SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — the app screenshots ITSELF; the user's desktop is off-limits. Marker: SELFSHOT-0606, ledger req_0019.

USER RULING, verbatim: "i stopped everyone. if anyone wants to get screenshots. they need to figure it out without using my desktop. make a command to get the proper screenshot of whatever u need, dont look at the system."

The standing violation this kills: lanes have been using X11 desktop capture (import -window) to verify their UI work — that reads the user's screen/system. From this ruling forward that is BANNED. The replacement is a first-class capability: the app captures its own framebuffer.

BUILD:
1. HOST CAPTURE DOOR — a host fn (e.g. __capture_frame(path)) that writes the current rendered frame (the swapchain/offscreen target the GPU already composed) to a PNG at a given path. Framework-side, V18-gated like every capability (has-* flag, thin registrar, conditional — 2D/sweatshop carts pay zero). Investigate what the GPU layer already has: there is a cart-side autotest screenshot harness and an icon_atlas debug dump (framework/gpu/icon_atlas_debug.ppm.txt) — find the existing readback machinery and build on it; if real readback machinery exists, extend it rather than inventing parallel paths. If a piece is genuinely missing in the GPU layer, STOP and report what is missing before writing framework code.
2. CONSOLE + CLI VERBS — (a) a console command (the V19 vocabulary): `shot [path]` captures the live app's current frame; (b) a CLI flow for headless verification: boot the cart, navigate to a route (the existing dev/ship machinery), capture after N frames, exit — so a lane can verify any surface without ANY display attachment. Naming/UX per the existing command conventions.
3. CONDUCT RULE — one block in the worker conduct doc (where the ledger rule lives): desktop/X11 capture of the user's system is banned; self-verification uses the shot command; cite it in reports. Failure framing: desktop captures got every lane stopped on 2026-06-06.
4. Tests: a P4/smoke that captures a frame headless and asserts a non-empty, plausibly-sized PNG; verify green; explicit paths; docs + _index contract; resolve req_0019 with paragraph + SHAs.

DONE BAR: you demonstrate it yourself — capture a frame of a running route via the console verb AND via the headless CLI flow, list the PNGs (sizes), zero desktop access anywhere in your method. READY FOR USER TEST.
